mapper.sql:
FROM sal_order o LEFT JOIN base_customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = o.create_by AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0
AND (o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS billNo, c.name AS partyName, DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS billDate, o.total_amount AS amount, o.status AS status, IFNULL(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username) AS makerName
ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

FROM sal_outstock o LEFT JOIN base_customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = o.create_by AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0
AND (o.out_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT o.id, o.out_no AS billNo, c.name AS partyName, DATE_FORMAT(o.out_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS billDate, o.total_amount AS amount, o.status AS status, IFNULL(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username) AS makerName
ORDER BY o.out_date DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

FROM pur_order o LEFT JOIN base_supplier s ON s.id = o.supplier_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = o.create_by AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0
AND (o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS billNo, s.name AS partyName, DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS billDate, o.total_amount AS amount, o.status AS status, IFNULL(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username) AS makerName
ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

FROM fin_voucher v LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = v.create_by AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE v.deleted = 0
AND v.voucher_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT v.id, v.voucher_no AS billNo, IFNULL(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username) AS partyName, DATE_FORMAT(v.voucher_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS billDate, v.total_debit AS amount, v.status AS status, v.word AS word
ORDER BY v.voucher_date DESC, v.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.sql: FROM sal_outstock o JOIN base_customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 10 AND o.out_date >= #{from} AND o.out_date < #{to}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id)

SELECT c.id AS id, c.code AS billNo, c.name AS partyName, DATE_FORMAT(#{from}, '%Y-%m') AS billDate, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS billCount, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS amount
GROUP BY c.id, c.code, c.name ORDER BY amount DESC, c.id LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS orderNo, DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS orderDate, o.total_qty AS totalQty, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.status AS status, o.remark AS remark, c.code AS custCode, c.name AS custName, c.contact AS custContact, c.phone AS custPhone, c.address AS custAddress, w.name AS warehouseName, IFNULL(NULLIF(m.nickname, ''), m.username) AS makerName, IFNULL(NULLIF(a.nickname, ''), a.username) AS auditorName, DATE_FORMAT(o.audit_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS auditDate FROM sal_order o LEFT JOIN base_customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user m ON m.id = o.create_by AND m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user a ON a.id = o.audit_by AND a.deleted = 0 WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.deleted = 0

SELECT m.code AS matCode, m.name AS matName, m.spec AS matSpec, u.name AS unitName, d.qty AS qty, d.price AS price, d.amount AS amount, d.remark AS remark FROM sal_order_detail d LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = d.material_id AND m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_unit u ON u.id = m.unit_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE d.order_id = #{orderId} AND d.deleted = 0 ORDER BY d.id

SELECT o.id, o.out_no AS outNo, o.order_no AS orderNo, DATE_FORMAT(o.out_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS outDate, o.total_qty AS totalQty, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.status AS status, o.remark AS remark, c.code AS custCode, c.name AS custName, c.contact AS custContact, c.phone AS custPhone, c.address AS custAddress, w.name AS warehouseName, IFNULL(NULLIF(m.nickname, ''), m.username) AS makerName, IFNULL(NULLIF(a.nickname, ''), a.username) AS auditorName, DATE_FORMAT(o.audit_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS auditDate FROM sal_outstock o LEFT JOIN base_customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user m ON m.id = o.create_by AND m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user a ON a.id = o.audit_by AND a.deleted = 0 WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.deleted = 0

SELECT m.code AS matCode, m.name AS matName, m.spec AS matSpec, u.name AS unitName, d.qty AS qty, d.price AS price, d.amount AS amount, d.remark AS remark FROM sal_outstock_detail d LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = d.material_id AND m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_unit u ON u.id = m.unit_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE d.out_id = #{outId} AND d.deleted = 0 ORDER BY d.id

SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS orderNo, DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS orderDate, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.status AS status, o.remark AS remark, s.code AS suppCode, s.name AS suppName, s.contact AS suppContact, s.phone AS suppPhone, s.address AS suppAddress, w.name AS warehouseName, IFNULL(NULLIF(m.nickname, ''), m.username) AS makerName, IFNULL(NULLIF(a.nickname, ''), a.username) AS auditorName, DATE_FORMAT(o.audit_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS auditDate FROM pur_order o LEFT JOIN base_supplier s ON s.id = o.supplier_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user m ON m.id = o.create_by AND m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user a ON a.id = o.audit_by AND a.deleted = 0 WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.deleted = 0

SELECT m.code AS matCode, m.name AS matName, m.spec AS matSpec, u.name AS unitName, d.qty AS qty, d.price AS price, d.tax_rate AS taxRate, d.amount AS amount, DATE_FORMAT(d.delivery_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS deliveryDate, d.remark AS remark FROM pur_order_detail d LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = d.material_id AND m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_unit u ON u.id = m.unit_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE d.order_id = #{orderId} AND d.deleted = 0 ORDER BY d.id

SELECT v.id, v.voucher_no AS voucherNo, v.word AS word, v.attachment_count AS attachmentCount, v.total_debit AS totalDebit, v.total_credit AS totalCredit, v.status AS status, v.remark AS remark, DATE_FORMAT(v.voucher_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS voucherDate, IFNULL(NULLIF(m.nickname, ''), m.username) AS makerName, IFNULL(NULLIF(a.nickname, ''), a.username) AS auditorName FROM fin_voucher v LEFT JOIN sys_user m ON m.id = v.create_by AND m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user a ON a.id = v.audit_by AND a.deleted = 0 WHERE v.id = #{id} AND v.deleted = 0

SELECT e.line_no AS lineNo, e.summary AS summary, s.code AS subjectCode, s.name AS subjectName, e.debit_amount AS debitAmount, e.credit_amount AS creditAmount FROM fin_voucher_entry e LEFT JOIN fin_subject s ON s.id = e.subject_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE e.voucher_id = #{voucherId} AND e.deleted = 0 ORDER BY e.line_no
SELECT c.id, c.code AS custCode, c.name AS custName, c.contact AS custContact, c.phone AS custPhone, c.address AS custAddress FROM base_customer c WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.deleted = 0

SELECT o.out_no AS outNo, o.order_no AS orderNo, DATE_FORMAT(o.out_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS outDate, m.code AS matCode, m.name AS matName, d.qty AS qty, d.amount AS amount FROM sal_outstock o JOIN sal_outstock_detail d ON d.out_id = o.id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = d.material_id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 10 AND o.customer_id = #{customerId} AND o.out_date >= #{from} AND o.out_date < #{to} ORDER BY o.out_date, o.out_no, d.id

SELECT COALESCE(c.init_receivable, 0) + COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(o.total_amount) FROM sal_outstock o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 10 AND o.customer_id = c.id AND o.out_date < #{from} ), 0) FROM base_customer c WHERE c.id = #{customerId} AND c.deleted = 0
